A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ActLCD study. Their complete text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices are readable and matchable, including relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, latency measurements, and supplementary analyses, including Table 1, Figure 2, and appendix results.

after.justification: v3 retains those empirical results and adds annotation-source and behavior-cloning ablation results in Tables 6 and 10.

M1.justification: The proposed decoding procedure, reward values, behavior cloning followed by constrained Q-learning, and inference rule remain unchanged. The new appendix experiments evaluate variants of the existing method.

E1.justification: Both versions use TruthfulQA, LongFact, StrategyQA, GSM8K, and Python/JavaScript package hallucination tasks. The new analyses use retained tasks; changing the annotation model does not introduce new data or task coverage.

E2.justification: v3 Appendix D/Table 10 adds BC-only ActLCD as an evaluated comparator against BC+RL for Llama-3.1 and Gemma-2. Greedy, DoLa, SLED, and threshold-based comparators remain unchanged in the existing comparisons.

E3.justification: The added experiments vary the annotation source between Llama-3-70B and GPT-4o and evaluate the policy before versus after RL. These introduce limited experimental controls on existing models and tasks; the original evaluation settings and metrics remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v3 adds direct tests of two central dependencies previously unexamined: whether RL improves upon behavior cloning alone and whether performance depends on GPT-4o annotations. Appendix A.1/Table 6 and Appendix D/Table 10 substantially extend component ablation and annotation robustness evidence, while retaining the earlier analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests for these evaluations. The new tables continue reporting point estimates.

E6.justification: Main results are unchanged, but v3 adds annotation-source and BC-only scores. For Llama-3.1, Table 6 reports StrategyQA 74.95 with Llama annotations versus 75.33 with GPT-4o; Table 10 reports 72.84 for BC-only versus 75.33 for BC+RL. Its Gemma-2 BC+RL GSM8K entry is 82.32, whereas Tables 1 and 6 report 83.32, without explaining the difference.

T1.justification: The MDP formulation, contrastive decoding equations, behavior-cloning loss, and constrained Q-learning equations remain unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, proofs, or derivations are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about active, sequentially optimized layer contrasting, factuality improvements across five benchmarks, and low inference overhead.

C2.justification: Appendix A.1 newly interprets the annotation comparison as evidence of robustness across annotation sources. Appendix D interprets the ablation as showing that RL refines an already strong BC policy. Existing mechanism explanations and limitations are retained.

D1.justification: v3 identifies Llama-3-70B as the alternative annotation model. The availability statement changes from release 'upon acceptance' in v1 Appendix G to 'soon' in v3 Appendix H; neither supplies an access location or establishes that code has been released.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, and positioning relative to contrastive decoding, retrieval, and self-correction remain unchanged.

P1.justification: The main prose is essentially unchanged. v3 adds short appendix sections A.1 and D, updates subsequent section references, and revises author order, affiliations, and the email block.

P2.justification: v3 adds Tables 6 and 10 and rearranges appendix material. The package-results table moves beside its discussion, Algorithm 1 moves to the following page, and existing tables are renumbered. Figures 1–3 and the main table layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v1 did not directly isolate RL's contribution or test annotation-source dependence. v3 adds useful controls addressing both, strengthening empirical support. The gain is limited by their two-model, two-task scope, absent uncertainty estimates, and the unexplained Gemma-2 GSM8K discrepancy between Table 10 and Tables 1 and 6.
